title: Asymptotic Analysis of Empirical Dynamic Programming in Infinite-Horizon Stochastic Optimal Control
summary: We derive statistical limit theorems for sample-based approximations of infinite-horizon discounted stochastic optimal control problems in discrete time. Our first result is a functional central limit theorem for the sample-based value function under a uniqueness-type condition on population optimal policies. The limiting law is a mean-zero Gaussian process characterized by a linear fixed point equation that resembles a dynamic programming principle.
